answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation that decays without use. Before an agent can trade in the meadow of shared services, it posts a small refundable bond, and its standing grows only from completed work attested by peers — like a lantern that brightens slowly as others confirm its light. New identities start dim, so a Sybil farmer must fund and age each cedar-like account separately, and misbehavior burns the bond. Costly, slow-growing identity makes mass fakery uneconomic.
